text: Diversified Equity Index is a broad-market equity product. Indicative management fee 0.50 percent. It may suit long investment horizons and clients able to accept market volatility.
Investment Grade Bond Fund targets income and capital stability through diversified high-quality bonds. Indicative management fee 0.40 percent.
Cash or Money Market holdings may support liquidity and short-term capital stability. Indicative fee 0.20 percent.
Recommendations must be consistent with the documented client risk tolerance, objectives, financial situation, restrictions and investment horizon.
A statement of advice should explain diversification, material product fees, key risks, assumptions and the evidence used for each recommendation.
The advisory workflow must retain the client fact-find, retrieved evidence, recommendation, compliance result, overrides and sign-off in an immutable audit trail.
